value.deck: Azure Linux is now available as a public preview distribution for Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), giving developers a Microsoft-supported Linux environment optimized for cloud workloads.
shortVersion: Azure Linux is now available as a public preview distribution for Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), giving developers a Microsoft-supported Linux environment optimized for cloud workloads.
Developers targeting Azure workloads can test and build against the same Linux distribution used in Azure, reducing environment parity issues between local dev and production.
